authority_basis: GOAL.json new_segment_allocation; existing PLUS scientific allocation unchanged

failure_classification.false_positive_transient: NOT_ESTABLISHED; failure-time blocking process identities were not saved
failure_classification.old_attempt_disposition: Consumed reservation retained; no deletion, counter reset or replay of old start-detached command

immutable_execution.rule: Retain historical source mappings and validation; no binary rebuild, physics, config or tolerance change

accounting.rule: Preserve old reserved charges; report attempts and observed solver starts separately

paths.allowed_mutation: New recovery launcher, binding, fixtures, review and evidence only under new_owned_root; authorized binary may create science_output after review
paths.preserved: All original cases, old observers/adapters/bindings/reviews/reservation/START/raw error evidence unchanged

implementation_contract: Thin recovery entrypoint uses existing reviewed validation, terminal reconciliation and monitoring logic
Accept only exact pre-Popen failed reservation, frozen hashes and absent acknowledged process/science output
Use fresh exclusive runtime/raw paths; never delete or reopen old reservation as unused
Keep unchanged science binary argv/config/predecessor/output; only launcher log paths move
Retain original handoff predicate unchanged in this segment; do not whitelist unexplained process
On handoff refusal capture blocking PID/PGID/start identity/argv and exact reason
Before sole Popen repeat immutable validation, receipt reconciliation, duplicate and local/remote/pending-slot checks
Persist charged recovery attempt before Popen and PID acknowledgement immediately after
Retain external limits, monitoring, terminal classification and raw first failure

preparation_limits.fixture_scope: Manufactured exact pre-Popen recovery; reject acknowledged/ambiguous start, existing output, changed binding, live group and repeated reservation; fake Popen at most once

launch_preconditions: Fresh independent changed-surface review passes code, fixture/raw evidence, exact binding/accounting
Old observer and worker groups exited naturally
Controller verifies remote and pending allocations; local+remote+pending science concurrency at most two
No other scheduler owns PLUS; reconcile reservations
Immutable identities and completed recovery receipt match
No PLUS solver acknowledgement or output; new runtime absent

transition.preparation_PASS: One invocation of new recovery entrypoint with frozen argv
transition.failure: First failure stops; retain inventory and charged second attempt; no retry/third attempt/predicate relaxation
transition.completion: Actual terminal/composed-history independent review; no admission from dispatch

HALF_MINUS_science_review.claim_ceiling: Partial interval only; no zbar4 completion, convergence, resolved signed response, absolute IVP certificate or broader scientific admission
